reference_traces.rationale: The reviewer identifies the added chromatin-status feature as enabling identification of BRCA-related homologous-recombination processes; the final paper incorporates chromatin status among the rearrangement-signature features and reports the associated RS1 findings.

The reviewer highlights the combination of mutational-signature modalities with rearrangement processes; the final paper reports the 170-genome analysis, rearrangement signatures, and subtype associations with molecular and epidemiological backgrounds.

The reviewer notes broad SV detection together with RNA-seq, experimental validation, and FISH support; the final paper documents callallSV validation, RNA-seq support for predicted fusions, and FISH validation of ecDNA/HSR signals.

The reviewer describes revisions concerning statistical tests, gene-fusion discussion, and comparisons with PCAWG and GenomonSV, but no author-response span is supplied to establish resolution of the underlying requests. This is retained only as an audit record.

supporting_points.text: The integration of chromatin status into rearrangement-signature analysis is a distinct contribution that supports attribution of the RS1 subtype to BRCA-related homologous-recombination deficiency.

strengths.text: The 170-genome analysis links rearrangement signatures and their subtypes to molecular, clinical, and epidemiological backgrounds, including BRCA-related homologous recombination, mismatch-repair deficiency, TP53 mutation, and smoking.

The structural-variant analysis is supported by caller validation, RNA-seq evidence for predicted fusion expression, and FISH validation of ecDNA and homogeneous staining-region signals in the examined cases.

summary.text: This work analyzes 170 gastric-cancer whole genomes to define six rearrangement signatures and seven signature subtypes, identify recurrent structural-variant hotspots and clustered-variant mechanisms, and connect RS6-associated amplicon profiles with ecDNA-related oncogene amplification.

revision_ledger.residual_summary: No author-response evidence is available to verify the resolution of the referenced prior comments; no issue is retained in the final review.
